description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier skilled nursing and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to oversee all aspects of facility management, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency.
The ideal candidate will be a visionary leader with a passion for enhancing the lives of residents and fostering a supportive environment for staff. You will be responsible for strategic planning, financial management, and maintaining a culture of excellence. Join a team committed to providing exceptional healthcare services and making a meaningful impact in the community.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in the State of Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting.
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations (e.g., CMS, OBRA).
Demonstrated ability to manage financial performance, human resources, and quality assurance programs.
Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation: $115,000 - $145,000 per year, based on experience.
